question: Direction: Read the passage and fill in the blanks. || Passage: The central bank has decided to (1)___ its monetary policy stance to combat the persistent inflation that has been eating into household savings. While some economists argue that this sudden shift might (2)___ the fragile economic recovery, the governor maintained that curbing price rise is the primary objective. The committee felt that the current geopolitical tensions could (3)___ further supply chain disruptions, thereby exacerbating the situation. Consequently, banks are expected to (4)___ their lending rates, making loans more expensive for consumers. Investors will have to (5)___ the storm until the macroeconomic indicators show signs of stabilization. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 1.
explanation: Yahan 'monetary policy' ki baat ho rahi hai. Economics mein jab central bank rules aur interest rates strict karta hai toh use 'tighten' karna kehte hain. Baki words jaise 'strict' adjective hai (humein verb chahiye), aur 'augment/fortify' increase aur strong karne ke liye hote hain par policy ke liye fit nahi hote.
trick: Collocation ka dhyan rakhein. Exam me monetary policy hamesha 'tighten' ya 'loosen' ki jati hai, is trap mein na fasein.
tip: Economy passages mein specific jargon (tighten) use hota hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 1, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 2.
explanation: Economic recovery ek train ya process ki tarah aage badhti hai. Agar wo raste se bhatak jaye ya fail ho jaye toh 'derail' (patri se utarna) use karte hain. 'Deflect' ka matlab direction badalna hota hai aur 'deter' ka matlab dar kar rokna hota hai jo insano ke liye aata hai.
trick: Economic recovery ya progress ko bigadne ke liye 'derail' ek standard metaphor hai editorial English mein, baaki words distracting lag sakte hain.
tip: Progress ya recovery ke ruin hone ko aksar derail kehte hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 1, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 3.
explanation: 'Bring about' ka matlab hai kisi cheez ka kaaran banna ya kuch produce karna (cause to happen). Yahan tension disruptions ka kaaran ban rahi hai. 'Set off' bomb blast ya alarm ke liye hota hai. 'Ring in' aur 'usher out' celebrations aur time periods ke liye aate hain.
trick: Phrasal verbs mein hamesha cause aur effect ka relation check karo. 'bring about changes/disruptions' ek fixed expression hai.
tip: Phrasal verb 'bring about' ka meaning 'cause to happen' hota hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 1, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 4.
explanation: Rates badhane ke liye transitive verb chahiye kyuki subject 'banks' object 'rates' ko bada rahe hain. Bank rate 'hike' karte hain. 'Surge' aur 'soar' intransitive hain (rates khud surge/soar hote hain, bank unhe surge nahi karta).
trick: Transitive vs Intransitive ka sabse bada trap hai! Bank 'hike' karte hain, jabki rates khud badhne par 'soar' hote hain.
tip: Subject-verb relationship check karein, transitive verbs pe dhyan dein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 1, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.
explanation: 'Weather the storm' ek idiom hai jiska matlab hai mushkil waqt se safely nikal jana. 'Survive' bhi sentence mein theek lag raha hai par idiom completely aur exactly 'weather' ke sath hi banta hai.
trick: Idioms hamesha fixed hote hain. Yahan 'survive the storm' padhne mein sahi lagega par standard idiom 'weather the storm' hi count hoga.
tip: Idioms mein words apni marzi se replace nahi kar sakte.

question: Direction: Read the passage and fill in the blanks. || Passage: The rapid integration of Artificial Intelligence in the workplace has sparked a heated debate regarding its long-term implications. Proponents believe that AI will (6)___ repetitive tasks, thereby freeing human workers to focus on creative problem-solving. Conversely, skeptics warn that widespread automation could (7)___ millions of low-skilled jobs, leading to unprecedented socio-economic inequalities. To mitigate these risks, corporations must (8)___ comprehensive upskilling programs to ensure their workforce remains relevant. Furthermore, governments need to step in and (9)___ robust regulatory frameworks to prevent the misuse of data. Ultimately, finding a balance between innovation and ethics will (10)___ the future of the digital economy. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 6.
explanation: AI tasks ko asaan aur efficient banata hai, jise 'streamline' karna kehte hain. 'Bypass' ka matlab toh process ko avoid karna ya chhod dena hota hai, jo context ke hisaab se galat hai.
trick: Passage ka tone dekho. AI repetitive tasks ko better/efficient banayega, isliye streamline best fit hai, channelize thoda odd lagta hai.
tip: Contextual tone agar positive aur efficiency wala hai toh streamline chunein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 6, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 7.
explanation: 'Wipe out' ka matlab hai puri tarah se khatam kar dena (destroy completely). Jobs ke completely destroy hone ke context mein yahi sabse apt phrasal verb hai. 'Wash away' paani ya flood ke zariye beh jane ke liye use hota hai.
trick: Jobs ya existence ke destroy hone ko hamesha 'wipe out' kehte hain. 'Clear off' aur 'clean up' saaf safai ke liye hote hain.
tip: Phrasal verb ka exact physical ya metaphorical use samjhein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 6, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 8.
explanation: Jab koi nayi scheme, program ya product launch hota hai, toh use officially 'roll out' karna kehte hain. 'Break out' bimari ya aag ke achanak shuru hone ke liye hota hai. 'Lay off' matlab naukri se nikalna jo negative hai.
trick: New programs ke official launch ke liye 'roll out' specific newspaper vocabulary hai, isme 'push through' lagake confuse mat hona.
tip: Naye programs ko launch karne ko roll out kehte hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 6, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 9.
explanation: Rules, laws, ya frameworks ko officially establish karne ke liye 'lay down' ka use hota hai (jaise: lay down the law). 'Set up' physically kuch build karne ya machinery/business start karne ke liye hota hai.
trick: Framework ya rules hamesha 'lay down' kiye jate hain. Collocation pe dhyan dein, 'put down' ka matlab suppress karna hota hai.
tip: Rules aur guidelines ke liye lay down best hota hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 6, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 10.
explanation: Yahan 'dictate' ka matlab hai kisi cheez ko strongly influence karna ya future decide karna. 'Order' aur 'decree' strictly legal/formal commands hain jo yahan fit nahi hote kyuki future ko command nahi diya jata, influence kiya jata hai.
trick: Dictate ka sirf negative meaning (tanashahi) nahi hota, kisi cheez ko deeply influence karne (like trends dictate fashion) ke liye bhi use hota hai.
tip: Words ke secondary meanings aur usage ko zarur dhyan mein rakhein.

question: Direction: Read the passage and fill in the blanks. || Passage: In rural India, accessing quality healthcare remains a daunting challenge, largely due to a severe shortage of medical professionals and inadequate infrastructure. Many villagers are forced to (11)___ quacks who offer unscientific remedies, often aggravating their ailments. Although the government has launched several schemes to bridge this gap, bureaucratic hurdles often (12)___ the effective implementation of these initiatives. A potential solution could be the extensive deployment of telemedicine services, which can (13)___ remote consultations with urban specialists. However, for this to work, the digital divide must be (14)___ through improved internet connectivity in remote areas. Until these foundational issues are resolved, the dream of universal healthcare will remain an (15)___ goal. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 11.
explanation: 'Fall back on' ka matlab hai jab aur koi option na ho toh kisi cheez ya insaan ka sahara lena. Quacks (jhola-chhap doctor) ka sahara majboori mein liya jata hai. 'Resort' ke sath 'to' aata hai, 'for' nahi isliye wo galat hai.
trick: Agar option mein 'resort to' hota toh wo sahi hota, par maine 'resort for' diya taaki aap prepositions pe dhyan dein. Fall back on perfect hai.
tip: Phrasal verbs ke prepositions ko dhyaan se check karein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 11, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 12.
explanation: 'Impede' ka matlab hai rukaawat daalna ya process slow down karna (hinder). 'Thwart' ka matlab hota hai kisi ke plan ko fail kar dena ya hara dena. Hurdles hamesha implementation ko slow (impede) karti hain.
trick: Bureaucratic hurdles implementation ko directly destroy ya 'thwart' nahi karti, balki unme rukawat (impede) daalti hain. Degree of action samjhein.
tip: Sentences mein rukaawat dalne ke liye impede suitable hota hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 11, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 13.
explanation: 'Facilitate' ka matlab hai kisi process ya action ko aasan ya possible banana. Telemedicine remote consultations (ek process) ko aasan banayega isliye yahan facilitate sabse accurate hai.
trick: Service kisi insaan ko 'assist' karti hai (Doctor assisted the patient), par process ya consultation ko hamesha 'facilitate' kiya jata hai.
tip: Processes aur actions hamesha facilitate hote hain, insaan assist hote hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 11, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 14.
explanation: 'Digital divide' (do sections of society ke beech ka inequality gap) ko kam karne ke liye standard term 'bridge the gap/divide' use hota hai. Baaki options literal sense mein use hote hain jo yahan awkward lagenge.
trick: Gap ya divide ko hamesha 'bridge' kiya jata hai, fill ya connect nahi. Ye the Hindu editorials ka bahut common collocation hai.
tip: Collocations (bridge the divide) advanced vocabulary ka base hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 11, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 15.
explanation: 'Elusive' ka matlab hai jise haasil karna, samjhna ya pakadna mushkil ho. 'Illusive' ka matlab hai jo illusion ho ya dhokha de. Healthcare ek aesa goal hai jise paana kathin hai, isliye elusive aayega.
trick: Homophones ka classical trap! Elusive (hard to catch/achieve) aur illusive (fake/illusion) sound same karte hain par context bilkul alag hai.
tip: Goal aur targets ke sath hamesha elusive ka prayog hota hai.

question: Direction: Read the passage and fill in the blanks. || Passage: The recent climate summit concluded with a mixed bag of promises, leaving environmentalists skeptical about the actual outcomes. While developed nations pledged to (16)___ their carbon emissions by half, developing countries argued for more financial support to transition to green energy. The failure to reach a consensus on coal phase-out threatens to (17)___ the progress made so far. Experts emphasize that mere rhetoric will not suffice; actionable policies must be (18)___ immediately. Moreover, corporations accused of greenwashing must be (19)___ to ensure transparency and accountability. If we continue to (20)___ the warning signs, irreversible ecological damage is inevitable. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 16.
explanation: 'Slash' ka matlab hai aggressively ya drastically cut karna. Emissions ko jab massive scale pe reduce kiya jata hai (like by half), toh 'slash' sabse strong aur appropriate word hota hai. Shrink physically size kam hone ke liye aata hai.
trick: 'Diminish' gradual reduction hota hai, lekin yahan 'by half' ek sudden aur drastic step dikhata hai, jiske liye slash best hai.
tip: Action ki intensity check karke strong ya weak word select karein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 16, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 17.
explanation: Progress ko nullify ya waste kar dene ke liye 'undo the progress' phrase use hota hai. 'Revoke' aur 'rescind' official ya legal orders ko cancel karne ke liye use hote hain (e.g. revoke a driving license).
trick: Progress hamesha 'undo' ki jati hai. Revoke ek pure legal jargon hai jo general progress ke context me padhne mein achha lagega par galat hoga.
tip: Context legal hai ya general, ye pehchan kar option eliminate karein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 16, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 18.
explanation: 'Put in place' ka matlab hota hai laws ya policies ko properly lagu karna (establish/implement). 'Set in motion' kisi event, chain reaction ya process ko start karne ke liye use hota hai, policy establish karne ke liye nahi.
trick: Policies aur systems hamesha 'put in place' hoti hain taaki wo systematically function kar sakein. Set in motion actions ke liye hota hai.
tip: Phrases ka exact object (policies vs actions) matching zaroori hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 16, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 19.
explanation: 'Call out' ka matlab hota hai kisi ke galat kaam ki publicly alochana (criticize) karna. Yahan greenwashing (fake eco-friendly bolke dhokha dene wali companies) ki sacchai expose karne ki baat ho rahi hai.
trick: Galtiyo ko publicly expose karne ko modern English editorials mein commonly 'called out' likha jata hai, baaki options totally irrelevant hain.
tip: Kisi ki galti ko sarvjanik roop se nindniya batane ko call out kehte hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 16, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 20.
explanation: 'Ignore' ka matlab hai jaan bujh kar dhyan na dena. 'Neglect' careless hone ki wajah se duty puri na karna hota hai aur 'overlook' galti se chhoot jana hota hai. Warning signs ko intentionally an-dekha kiya ja raha hai, isliye ignore aayega.
trick: Warnings hamesha intentionally 'ignore' ki jati hain. Duty ya responsibility ke case mein neglect aata hai aur chhoti mistake pe overlook aata hai.
tip: Words ke piche ki intent (intentional vs accidental) pe dhyan dein.

question: Direction: Read the passage and fill in the blanks. || Passage: The Indian startup ecosystem, once hailed as a global marvel, is currently going through a severe funding winter. Many unicorns that previously managed to (21)___ massive capital on the back of aggressive growth projections are now finding it increasingly difficult to (22)___ their sky-high valuations. Consequently, several companies have had to (23)___ drastic cost-cutting measures, including mass layoffs and halting rapid expansion plans. Investors, who were earlier driven by a fear of missing out, have now become highly risk-averse. They are carefully scrutinizing the path to profitability, demanding that founders immediately (24)___ their cash burn rates. However, industry veterans remain optimistic. They argue that this consolidation phase will ultimately (25)___ the weak players and leave the market healthier. In the long run, only startups with sustainable business models will (26)___ the test of time. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 21.
explanation: Rake in ka matlab hota hai bahut saara paisa kamana ya ikattha karna (to earn or get a large amount of money). Rope in ka matlab kisi ko apne kaam me shamil karne ke liye manana hota hai. Dish out matlab free me baantna, aur drum up matlab support ya interest jutana. Yahan capital (paisa) ikattha karne ki baat ho rahi hai.
trick: Capital ya money ke context me hamesha 'rake in' ek strong phrasal verb hota hai. Rope in insaano (people) ke liye use hota hai, is trap me na fasein.
tip: Paise ya profit batorne ko hamesha rake in kehte hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 21, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 22.
explanation: Justify ka matlab hota hai kisi cheez (jaise valuation ya action) ko sahi sabit karna rational reasons de kar. Vindicate ka matlab kisi par lage arop (blame) ko galat sabit karna hota hai. Corroborate aur authenticate evidence ya documents ko verify karne ke liye use hote hain.
trick: Business context me high valuations, expenses, ya decisions ko hamesha 'justify' kiya jata hai. Vindicate sirf tab aata hai jab kisi pe ilzaam laga ho.
tip: Numbers aur decisions ko sahi thehrane ke liye justify chunein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 21, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 23.
explanation: Resort to ka matlab hota hai majboori me koi aesa rasta apnana jo ideal na ho (like drastic cost-cutting). Fall back ke sath 'on' aana zaroori hai tabhi uska meaning majboori me sahara lena banta hai. Lean on insaano ya support ke liye hota hai.
trick: Resort hamesha 'to' preposition leta hai aur iska use extreme ya negative actions (jaise violence, layoffs) apnane ke liye hota hai.
tip: Majboori wale extreme actions ke liye resort to best hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 21, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 24.
explanation: Rein in ka matlab hota hai kisi cheez ko control me lana ya limit karna (jaise kharche ya cash burn rate). Clamp down ka matlab kade niyam lagana (suppress) hota hai, jo authority public par karti hai. Phase out ka matlab dhire dhire khatam karna hota hai.
trick: Kharche (expenses), inflation, ya burn rates ko lagam lagane ke liye newspaper editorials me 'rein in' sabse standard idiom hai. Ghode ki lagam ko rein kehte hain.
tip: Expenses aur inflation ko control karne ko rein in kehte hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 21, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 25.
explanation: Weed out ka matlab hota hai kisi system se kharab ya weak elements ko chun kar bahar nikal dena. Wipe off aur sweep away ka matlab puri tarah se mita dena ya tabah kar dena hota hai, jo yahan bahut extreme ho jayega. Market weak players ko filter karke nikalegi.
trick: Wipe off aur sweep away physical destruction ke liye jyada aate hain. System se kharab logo ya companies ko hatane ki process ko hamesha 'weed out' kehte hain.
tip: Kharab elements ko system se nikalne ko weed out kehte hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 21, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 26.
explanation: Yahan idiom 'stand the test of time' ban raha hai, jiska matlab hai lambe samay tak successful ya intact rehna. Endure, weather, aur survive akele meaning me sahi lagte hain, lekin 'the test of time' ke sath strictly 'stand' use hota hai.
trick: Phrasal verbs aur idioms me apni taraf se words replace nahi kar sakte. Meaning wise weather/survive theek lagega par phrase 'stand the test of time' fixed hai.
tip: Idioms hamesha fixed hote hain, unme variations allow nahi hote.

question: Direction: Read the passage and fill in the blanks. || Passage: In an era where data is increasingly considered the new oil, the unchecked proliferation of digital platforms has (27)___ serious privacy concerns globally. Users unknowingly generate massive digital footprints every day, which tech giants aggressively (28)___ to deliver hyper-targeted advertising. While governments across the world are attempting to formulate stringent data protection laws, the rapid pace of technological innovation often (29)___ legislative efforts. Furthermore, cyberattacks are becoming increasingly sophisticated, leaving both individuals and giant corporations extremely vulnerable. To successfully (30)___ these emerging threats, cybersecurity experts advocate for the widespread adoption of zero-trust architectures. (31)___, a significant portion of the population remains digitally illiterate, making them incredibly easy targets for phishing scams and identity theft. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 27.
explanation: Engendered ka matlab hota hai kisi feeling, situation, ya condition ko paida karna (to cause or give rise to). Concerns (chinta) hamesha engender hoti hain. Precipitate ka matlab kisi buri cheez ko achanak se hone par majboor karna. Instigate negative sense me (bhadkana) aata hai.
trick: Jab bhi 'concerns' ya 'issues' aage ho, toh unhe paida karne ke liye 'engender' ya 'spark' ka prayog hota hai. Instigate hamesha dange ya ladai ke liye hota hai.
tip: Concerns aur issues ko paida karne ke liye engender chunein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 27, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 28.
explanation: Corporate aur tech world me data ya resources ka apne fayde ke liye use karne ko 'leverage' karna kehte hain. Exploit thoda negative sound karta hai (shoshan karna). Harness basically natural energy (sun, wind) ke liye aata hai. Capitalize ke sath 'on' aana zaroori hai.
trick: Capitalize tabhi answer hoga jab blank ke baad 'on' likha ho. Data aur assets ko modern business English me strongly 'leverage' likha jata hai.
tip: Business resources ka fayda uthane ko leverage karna kehte hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 27, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 29.
explanation: Outpaces ka matlab hota hai kisi doosri cheez se zyada tezi se aage badhna (develop faster than something else). Technology laws banane ki speed se zyada tez badh rahi hai isliye outpaces aayega. Outstrips supply/demand ke difference me zyada use hota hai.
trick: Pace (speed) ki baat ho rahi hai 'rapid pace of technological innovation', isliye speed me aage nikalne ke liye logically 'outpaces' best word match hai.
tip: Speed aur progress me aage nikalne ko outpace karna kehte hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 27, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 30.
explanation: Ward off ka matlab hota hai kisi khatre, beemari, ya attack ko khud se door rakhna ya rokna. Beat back physical ladai me use hota hai. Fend for ka matlab apna khayal khud rakhna hota hai (fend for yourself). Threats ko ward off kiya jata hai.
trick: Cyber threats, illness, ya evil spirits ko door rakhne ke liye common phrasal verb 'ward off' hi hai. Is collocation ko hamesha dhyan rakhein.
tip: Khatre ya beemari ko door rakhne ko ward off kehte hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 27, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 31.
explanation: Pichli line me advanced tech (zero-trust architecture) ki baat hui, aur next line me likha hai ki log basic digital literacy bhi nahi rakhte. Ye ek virodhabhas (irony) hai. Consequently aur Accordingly results dikhate hain, jo yahan fit nahi hain.
trick: Connectors ke liye hamesha pichla sentence aur current sentence ka relation dekho. Yahan high-tech solution aur low-tech reality ka contrast hai, so 'Ironically' right hai.
tip: Jab umeed se ulta aur ajeeb situation ho toh Ironically aata hai.

question: Direction: Read the passage and fill in the blanks. || Passage: Agriculture remains the backbone of the Indian economy, yet farmers continually face a myriad of challenges. Erratic monsoon patterns, further exacerbated by climate change, often (32)___ havoc on crop yields, plunging marginal farmers into a vicious cycle of debt. Although the state provides minimum support prices for certain crops, the procurement infrastructure is heavily skewed and fails to (33)___ the majority of the farming community. To (34)___ the ongoing agrarian crisis, policymakers must swiftly shift their focus from mere temporary subsidies to building robust supply chains and irrigation networks. Unless structural reforms are executed efficiently at the ground level, the agricultural sector will continue to (35)___ under the heavy weight of systemic inefficiencies. It is imperative that all stakeholders collaborate seamlessly to (36)___ a sustainable and profitable future for Indian agriculture. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 32.
explanation: Wreak ka matlab hota hai nuksan pahunchana. Havoc (tabahi) ke sath hamesha 'wreak' ka collocation banta hai ('wreak havoc' = tabahi machana). Inflict pain ya punishment ke sath aata hai (inflict pain). Hurl aur cast physically fekne ke liye aate hain.
trick: Phrases aur unke words fixed hote hain. Havoc dekh kar bina soche 'wreak' mark kar sakte hain, ye English vocabulary ka golden rule hai.
tip: Havoc (tabahi) shabd ke sath hamesha wreak lagaya jata hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 32, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 33.
explanation: Cater to ka matlab hota hai kisi specific group ki zaruraton (needs) ko pura karna. Yahan infrastructure majority farmers ki needs puri nahi kar pa raha. Provide for kisi individual ki basic needs (roti, kapda) dene ke liye use hota hai.
trick: Cater hamesha 'to' preposition leta hai aur jab kisi target audience ya community ki needs puri karne ki baat ho, toh yahi sabse apt phrase hai.
tip: Community ki zaruraton ko pura karne ke liye cater to use hota hai.

question: Based on the passage in Question 32, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 34.
explanation: Alleviate ka matlab hota hai dard ya samasya (crisis/pain) ko kam karna. Pacify aur appease gusse me aaye logo ko shant karne ke liye use hote hain (insano ke liye). Assuage guilt ya fears ke liye zyada use hota hai. Crisis ko hamesha alleviate karte hain.
trick: Subject aur object ka nature dekho. Agrarian crisis ek samasya hai, insaan nahi. Isliye pacify ya appease turant eliminate ho jayenge.
tip: Samsya ya dard ki intensity kam karne ko alleviate kehte hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 32, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 35.
explanation: Languish ka matlab hota hai kisi buri sthiti me majboor hokar pade rehna aur suffer karna. Stagnate ka matlab bas ruk jana (no growth) hota hai, par yahan 'under the heavy weight' likha hai jo suffering darshata hai. Perish matlab mar jana, jo yahan over-dramatic hai.
trick: Blank ke baad 'under the heavy weight' hint kar raha hai ki koi cheez dab kar dukh jhel rahi hai. Aise context me languish newspaper ki standard pasand hai.
tip: Buri sthiti me kamzor hokar pade rehne ko languish kehte hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 32, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 36.
explanation: Carve out ka matlab hota hai mehnat karke koi nayi aur behtar position ya future banana (to create or obtain something with effort). Chalk out aur draw up ka matlab sirf plans banana (draft karna) hota hai. Yahan actual future create karne ki baat ho rahi hai.
trick: Future, niche, ya career jab mehnat se banaya jata hai toh use hamesha 'carve out' kehte hain (jaise patthar tarash kar murti banana).
tip: Mehnat se apna behtar rasta ya future banane ko carve out kehte hain.

question: Direction: Read the passage and fill in the blanks. || Passage: The recent resurgence in space exploration has definitively shifted the paradigm from solely state-sponsored missions to aggressive commercial ventures. Private aerospace companies are now competing fiercely to (37)___ the astronomical costs of launching payloads into orbit by developing highly reusable rockets. This rapid democratization of space access is highly expected to (38)___ a new era of satellite-based services, ranging from ubiquitous global broadband to advanced weather monitoring. However, the exponential increase in orbital traffic has led to growing concerns about dangerous space debris. If the international community fails to (39)___ strict regulations on satellite deployments, the massive accumulation of space junk could eventually render low Earth orbit completely unusable. Therefore, technological advancement must go hand in hand with responsible global stewardship to (40)___ the long-term viability of our extraterrestrial endeavors. || Question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 37.
explanation: Drive down ka matlab hota hai prices, costs, ya inflation ko zabardasti kam karna ya girana. Pull down kisi building ko gira dene ke liye use hota hai. Bring under control ke reference me aata hai. Costs ko humesha drive down kiya jata hai.
trick: Economy aur business passages me prices/costs ko force se kam karne ke liye 'drive down' ek standard phrasal verb hai. Pull down mark karke galti na karein.
tip: Kimat (costs/prices) ko aggressively kam karne ko drive down kehte hain.

question: Based on the passage in Question 37, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 38.
explanation: Usher in ka matlab hota hai kisi naye yug, era, ya phase ki shuruat ka kaaran banna (to mark the beginning of a new era). Roll out specific products ya schemes ke launch ke liye hota hai, pure 'new era' ke liye nahi. Bring off ka matlab mushkil kaam me safal hona.
trick: Jab bhi blank ke aage 'a new era', 'a new phase' ya 'a period of' likha ho, wahan 99% chances me answer 'usher in' hi hota hai.
tip: Naye daur (new era) ki shuruat ke liye hamesha usher in lagayein.

question: Based on the passage in Question 37, select the most appropriate option for blank No. 39.
